items.summary: WPP (LSE:WPP) and rival Publicis have entered a rare public dispute over how major advertising accounts are awarded. The clash focuses on so called pitchless wins for global clients such as Coca Cola and PepsiCo and the fairness of such processes. Both groups are using the row to question each other's approach to client acquisition, technology use and internal operating models.
